svg.title: memory
svg.desc: Average memory for all servers. Values from the source, with GiB converted to MiB for the common log axis. Missing results are marked not run.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(6%,9%,12%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,41%,21%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.aria-label: Average memory / lower is better / logarithmic scale / identical axes across profiles
Lowest memory: doba 11 MiB in baseline / doba 12 MiB in pipelined
512 connections / lite mode / 1 run per server and profile
Local measurement. Hardware and run date not supplied. One run: variability not estimated.
